name: pink-elephant-guard
title_zh: 删掉的词条从此不再溜回成稿
tagline_zh: 改稿时你说「这个不要了」，它记进黑名单。之后生成任何对外文案、画面、对话，被否的旧概念都不会再冒头。
tagline_en: When you say 'drop this' during edits, it's blacklisted. Future drafts, visuals, or dialogue won't resurrect that.
desc_en: Prevent rejected, removed, corrected, or forbidden concepts from resurfacing as the topic of a final deliverable. Use after requests such as 「これは消して」「その案はなし」「入れないで」「そこじゃない」 when revising copy, visuals, dialogue, summaries, labels, UI, or other viewer-facing output; do not use when comparison, compliance, safety, accessibility, or change history explicitly requires naming the excluded item.
why_zh: 不是靠提示词碰运气，而是把「已否决」变成硬约束，在每次产出前过滤。比人肉盯稿省心。
why_en: Turns 'rejected' into a hard constraint, filtering every output before it's shown. More reliable than eyeballing drafts or.
limit_zh: 只拦「最终交付物」里的主题复现，不拦过程稿、对比稿、合规审查或变更记录里必须点名旧概念的场景。
limit_en: Only blocks the rejected concept from resurfacing as the topic of final deliverables—not in process drafts, comparisons, compliance, or change logs.
title_en: Keep deleted terms from sneaking back into your final copy
